summary: Iter20 tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 15/15 PASS on new suite test_iter20_branding_diff_filter.py: (1) BRANDING endpoint — GET default null values, PUT full payload persists via GET refresh, PUT empty string clears field to null, PUT logo_b64 >500 000 chars returns 413. (2) PDF WITH BRANDING — After PUT branding {company_name, contact_line, logo_b64=TINY_PNG}, PDF is 200 + magic '%PDF-' + starts >2000 bytes AND is strictly larger than the plain-user PDF baseline (logo header inflates size). Cleared-branding user gets fallback PDF (still valid PDF). Invalid base64 logo does NOT crash the export (silent fallback ok). (3) NON-RÉGRESSION — takeoffs full pipeline (upload/calibrate/rooms/measure/takeoff/materials/history/restore), detect-walls, room-autofill, compare, calculators/roof_facade, estimation/compute, prices/optimize, admin/revenue/kpis, share/sms/config, push/public-key — ALL pass with corrected schemas. FRONTEND Playwright — /plan post-upload: branding-open-btn + plan-pdf-export-btn visible; branding-dialog opens with all 3 inputs (company/contact/logo); save persists (reopen shows saved company name). History tab: after 3 mutations (calibrate + 2 room_upsert) shows 3 history-item entries; every item has a history-diff-{snap_id} with correct summary ('+1 (Cuisine)', '+1 (Salon)', 'État initial' for the calibrate=oldest) AND the HTML title attribute matches. Compare page: after selecting 2 plans and clicking Comparer, all 4 filter checkboxes (compare-filter-added, -removed, -modified, -hide-unchanged) are present and toggleable; toggling hide-unchanged correctly hides the compare-unchanged block (visible→hidden). Overlay canvas re-renders correctly on each toggle without console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/phase7.py PUT /users/me/branding: correct empty-string→null clearing via .strip()[:120] or None; 500 000 char b64 cap enforced with 413. Note: cap counts the base64 payload only after stripping the data-URL prefix (split(',')[-1]) — good.
routes/plans.py export_takeoff_pdf: correctly fetches user branding from the users collection and only passes a non-null dict when at least one branding field is set; falls back cleanly otherwise.

engines/pdf_takeoff.py build_takeoff_pdf(branding=...): wraps logo decoding in try/except so an invalid base64 doesn't crash export — verified with malformed logo test. Consider logging the exception for observability.

PlanTakeoff.jsx computeSnapshotDiff: correct DESC handling — iterates history[idx+1] as prev; correctly shows 'État initial' for the oldest snapshot. As noted in the spec, a room name-only change is NOT detected (only surface delta > 0.01) — acceptable for MVP.
PlanCompare.jsx: 4 filter checkboxes wired correctly to canvas overlay re-render and unchanged block conditional rendering. No console errors on toggle.
seed_data_creation: 3 plans uploaded via /api/takeoffs/upload using /app/before.png; branding PUT with tiny 1x1 red PNG base64; mutations = calibrate + 2 room_upsert per plan (Salon/Cuisine/Chambre variants for compare test). Branding cleared at end of PDF-invalid-logo test to leave demo user clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter20 green across the board. Reused iter19 mutation-pre-write snapshot semantic (see iter19 report) — computeSnapshotDiff on the oldest snapshot returns 'État initial' since prev is undefined. Native browser navigation to /plan/{plan_id} is NOT supported (only /plan) — to test history/tab-history the flow is: upload via UI, list plans via GET /api/takeoffs to grab the plan_id, then POST calibrate/rooms via API, then click tab-history in the same session. Compare page uses Radix Select combobox (not native <select>) with 67 options in demo account — pick options by text_content match against filename or plan_id suffix. Backend pytest ran with -n 0 (serial) via /app/backend/pytest.ini defaults.
